sections.heading: Sharmila Tagore — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Sharmila Tagore was born on 8 December 1944 in Hyderabad, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Gitindranath Tagore and her mother, Ira Barua.
She received her education at Loreto Convent, Asansol and St. John's Diocesan Girls' Higher Secondary School.
She is recorded as speaking Hindi and Bangla.
